description: This file contains functions for resolving and configuring npm command execution environments, with platform-specific handling for Windows and POSIX systems. It includes utility functions for path resolution, command-line escaping, and determining the npm toolchain location relative to a Node.js executable.

methods.name: resolvePathEnvKey
methods.description: Finds the environment variable key that corresponds to the system PATH, defaulting to 'PATH' if not found.

methods.name: escapeForCmdExe
methods.description: Escapes a command-line argument for safe inclusion in Windows cmd.exe commands, checking for unsafe characters.

methods.name: buildCmdExeCommandLine
methods.description: Constructs a command line string for cmd.exe, escaping arguments appropriately.

methods.name: resolveToolchainNpmRunner
methods.description: Locates the npm CLI script or executable relative to the Node.js directory, returning command configuration.
